lines.2: The Ryuumeikan student-council room, also known as Ryugu.
lines.3: It was the executive committee's workplace.

lines.5: 「And that concludes my report on the suspicious person from the other day.」
lines.6: 「She caused no harm, but she is exceptionally capable. If you spot her, inform me.」
lines.7: 「Hmm. A beautiful blonde with a ponytail, huh? As someone with a similar hairstyle, I'm curious.」
lines.8: 「She was definitely beautiful, but I still think the Princess is number one.」
lines.11: 「And I stiiiill think pwecious Pwincess is number oooone!」
lines.12: 「Hey, crustacean. Are you making fun of me?」
lines.13: 「I think your Kinu impression is pretty good, Senpai.」
lines.14: 「Hah. I don't care if a gloomy first-year compliments me.」
lines.15: 「You're really picking a fight with me right now?」
lines.16: 「Shut up! You piss me off every second of every day! Go put on that stupid little smirk and make some boric-acid roach bait or something!」
lines.17: 「Come to think of it, that actress Inugami Honami I saw at Dobuzaka yesterday was insanely beautiful too... And the twintailed girl with her was crazy cute.」
lines.18: 「I was gonna follow them and find out where they lived, but Subaru stopped me. What a pain in the ass.」
lines.19: 「I don't want one of my friends turning into a stalker.」
lines.22: 「Sorry, don't abandon me. Without Subaru around, I can't act tough in front of other guys.」
lines.24: 「Hey, Inori, tell my fortune. How can I get those women to date me?」
lines.25: 「The answer is: impossible for the rest of your life.」
lines.28: 「If you absolutely must meet them again, reset your life and hope you're reborn as something better next time.」
lines.31: 「If you keep hogging the spotlight, people might find you annoying.」
lines.33: 「Just kidding. Everyone else was teasing you, so I got carried away too... Sorry.」
lines.35: 「How Otome-senpai's been stealing everybody's snacks lately.」
lines.36: Wait, was that really the topic?
lines.37: 「I'm a third-year. I see no reason I should be criticized for eating things belonging to you juniors.」
lines.38: 「There it is. The sports-club hierarchy argument.」
lines.39: 「The scary part is she actually believes it. Education is terrifying.」
lines.40: 「Eating all twelve bags of my chocolate sticks is not forgivable.」
lines.41: 「Ugh... I-I'm sorry. I assumed anything chocolate belonged to the Princess and just...」
lines.42: Sports-club types are strong against juniors and weak against seniors.
lines.43: 「As punishment, go buy me the same thing at the candy shop near the station.」
lines.47: 「I think it defeats the point unless you go yourself, Otome-senpai.」
lines.48: 「At home and in my club, juniors always show respect to their elders... When I was a first-year, I always made sure my seniors kept face...」
lines.49: Otome headed out shopping, grumbling under her breath.
lines.50: 「Sounds like people above her pushed her around quite a bit when she was younger.」
lines.51: The Princess gave a wry smile.
lines.52: 「When you think about it that way, education really is important.」
lines.53: 「Then you should all be grateful that I'm your homeroom teacher.」
